model_annotation: The image displays two separate line plots comparing the training rewards over steps for two different algorithms, Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY, across an Easy and a Hard training set. In the top plot, labeled "Easy Training Set," the x-axis represents "Steps" ranging from 0 to approximately 500 on a linear scale, while the y-axis represents "Training Rewards" ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, also on a linear scale. The blue line, representing "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.35 by step 500. The red line, representing "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," starts near 0.0 and rises more steeply to approximately 0.4 by step 500. In the bottom plot, labeled "Hard Training Set," the x-axis and y-axis have identical scales and labels as the top plot. The blue line, "Llama-On-Policy-Hard," starts near 0.0 and quickly declines to near 0.0 by step 100, remaining near zero. The red line, "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," starts near 0.0 and rises steadily to approximately 0.2 by step 500.
